title: AudioEvent
description: A scheduled sample playback for one CommittedStrike (Phase 01 contract; produced by audio, Phase 04). docs/architecture/contracts.md section 3.9.

t_audio_scheduled.description: Instant the audio engine received the request (README section 5.2).

t_audio_out_est.description: ESTIMATED instant the first sample leaves the DAC: the buffer/sample placement time plus the MEASURED audio output latency of audio_profile_id (Phase 04, Task 04.8). This is an estimate, never a measured t_audio_out; external measurement is Phase 18.

audio_late_s.description: Seconds by which t_target_play was already in the past when placed (0 when scheduled in the future). Phase 04 late-event rule.

audio_profile_id.description: Id of the audio device profile whose measured output latency was used.
